roles.title: Executive Secretary
roles.organisation: United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change Secretariat

details.imageSource: De Boer, 20 March 2007, New York, Photo UN7717555, Photographer Mark Garten
details.summary: Dutch civil servant and third Executive Secretary of the United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change (UNFCCC) Secretariat, 2006-2010
details.life: Was born 12 June 1954 in Vienna, Austria. He is the son of Willem Pieter Lambertus Gerardus de Boer, diplomat and ambassador, and Hedwig Maria Yvonne Licini. In 1981 he married Sophie Welsing. He has two daughters and one son.
details.editors: Bob Reinalda, Kent J. Kille and Jaci L. Eisenberg
